items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Dimes played with him, and so did Buddy Petit. That's how I happened to play with him sometimes

ctx.x: Yes. Dimes played with him, and so did Buddy Petit. That's how I happened to play with him sometimes, on account of my teacher.
So in other words, you had a trumpet, a clarinet, a tenor, a trombone, a banjo and a drummer. What about bass? Did they have a bass?
